slice: W2 bounded ExecutionPlanView, readiness and advisory critical path

repository.scope: All W2 source and test hashes match the delivered implementation evidence.

focused_gate.command: env -u AGENT_COMMONS_STATE_ROOT -u AGENT_COMMONS_SESSION_ID uv run --locked python -m pytest -q tests/services/test_execution_plan.py

assertions: Derived ExecutionPlanView is deterministic, bounded and cycle-safe.
Readiness, blockers, ownership and next-action derive from existing canonical/operational sources.
Critical path is advisory only; no fake ETA, progress, token, cost or live claim is emitted.
Malformed, missing and stale sources result in typed bounded partial/error states.

safety.canonical_truth: This is evidence only; no authoritative run store is introduced.
safety.provider_data: No provider output, transcript, prompt, credentials or raw stderr is recorded.
